title: SPEAK LIFE INTO YOUR DAY BEFORE THE ENEMY DOES
text: Beloved, before we begin, I want you to do something for me. If this prayer, this word ministers to you, share it. Share it with somebody. There's a brother, there's a sister, there's a friend, there's a colleague who needs to hear this word. The enemy is planning his agenda for their day, and they need to interrupt that agenda with the word of God. So share this, send it, make sure it gets to them. The Bible says in Psalm 68-11, the Lord gave the word. Great was the company of those that published it. You become part of that great company when you share the word. Now lift up your hands wherever you are. And let's begin to engage heaven. Father, we bless your name this morning. We thank you because you are the God who neither slumbers nor sleeps. While we were sleeping, you were watching over us. Your eyes have been upon us. Your angels have been encamped around us and now we have come into a new day. A day that we have never seen before. A day filled with divine possibilities. And we declare that we shall speak life into this day before the enemy speaks death in the mighty name of Jesus. You see, there is a principle that many believers do not understand. The Bible says in Proverbs 18:21, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof." Now, this is not just a motivational statement. This is a spiritual law. God has given you a tongue, and that tongue is a weapon. It is an instrument of creation or destruction. Every morning when you wake up, there is a contest, a spiritual contest for the atmosphere of your day. The enemy wakes up with an agenda. Hear me. The devil does not sleep. He's looking for someone to speak defeat over, to speak failure over, to speak limitation over. But I came to tell you that you have the power to determine the spiritual climate of your day by what you speak. Before that phone call comes that wants to discourage you, you must have already spoken faith. Before that email arrives with that negative report, you must have already decreed the promises of God. Before you encounter that difficulty, you must have already prophesied your victory. This is the mystery of the morning hour. This is why the psalmist said in Psalm 5:3, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." Notice he didn't say in the afternoon or when I feel like it or when trouble comes. He said in the morning. There is something about the morning hour that gives you spiritual advantage. When you begin your day prophesying the word of God over your life, you are literally setting the spiritual thermostat for the next 24 hours, you are establishing boundaries that the enemy cannot cross. You are creating a canopy of divine protection and blessing. Now, let me teach you something from the book of Genesis. When God was creating the world, the Bible says in Genesis 1:3, "And God said, let there be light and there was light." God spoke before light manifested. God spoke it before the firmament appeared. God spoke it before the dry land emerged from the waters. God spoke it. Everything that exists in the physical realm was first spoken in the spiritual realm. This means that your day, your circumstances, your breakthroughs, your provisions, they must first be spoken before they manifest. The enemy knows this principle. This is why he bombards your mind with negative thoughts the moment you wake up. Fear, anxiety, worry, discouragement. These are seeds he wants to plant in your heart so that you will speak them with your mouth and create a negative atmosphere. But when you understand the power of speaking life, you interrupt his plan. You cancel his assignment. You overwrite his agenda with the agenda of heaven. Somebody shout, "I speak life into my day. I speak life into my family. I speak life into my finances. I speak life into my health. I speak life into my business in the mighty name of Jesus." Now, I want you to understand something. Speaking life is not the same as positive thinking. There are many people who confuse faith declarations with motivational speeches. No. When you speak life as a believer, you are not just speaking positive words. You are releasing the creative power of God. You are functioning in the same dimension that God functioned when he created the world. Romans 4:17 says, "God called those things which be not as though they were." This is divine protocol. This is how heaven operates. When you wake up in the morning and you say, "Father, I thank you that this day is blessed. I thank you that you make me to triumph in every place. I thank you that goodness and mercy are following me today. You are not just being optimistic. You are activating spiritual forces. You are dispatching angels. You are aligning yourself with the purposes of God. And when you speak in agreement with the word of God, heaven backs you up. The Bible says in Isaiah 55-11, "So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth. It shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it." If God's word cannot return void, and you are speaking God's word, then your words cannot return void either. When you decree a thing, it shall be established. Job 22:28 says, "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways." I want to pray with you right now. Lift up your hands. Father, in the name of Jesus, I pray for everyone who is hearing this word. I decree that their mouth shall become weapons of mass construction. Every negative word they have spoken in ignorance, we cancel it now by the blood of Jesus. Every curse they have pronounced over themselves unknowingly, we reverse it now in Jesus' name. And from this day forward, their tongue shall be saturated with the word of God. Their mouth shall be filled with divine decrees and everything they speak shall align with your will and your purpose. In the mighty name of Jesus, we pray. Now, let me show you something from the life of Jesus. When Jesus was tempted by the devil in the wilderness, how did he respond? Matthew 4:4 says, "But he answered and said, "It is written, man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeded out of the mouth of God." Every time the devil came with a temptation, Jesus responded with, "It is written." He used the word. He spoke the word. He didn't argue. He didn't debate. He didn't try to reason with the devil. He simply declared what was written. This is your strategy every morning. When the spirit of fear comes and says you're going to fail today, you don't entertain that conversation. You respond. It is written, I can do all things through Christ which strengthenth me. When the spirit of poverty comes and says, you will never have enough, you respond. It is written, my God shall supply all my need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus. When the spirit of sickness comes and says you're going to be sick, you respond. It is written, "By his stripes, I am healed." You must understand that the enemy is legalistic. He respects the word of God even though he hates it. When you speak the word, he has no choice but to bow. This is why Ephesians 6:17 calls the word of God the sword of the spirit. A sword is an offensive weapon. You are not just defending yourself when you speak the word. You are attacking. You are destroying the works of darkness. You are pulling down strongholds. Somebody lift up your voice and declare, "My mouth is a sword. My tongue is a weapon. Every word I speak is soaked in the blood of Jesus. And today I decree victory. I decree breakthrough. I decree supernatural provision in the mighty name of Jesus." Let me tell you what happens in the realm of the spirit when you speak life into your day. The Bible says in Psalm 103-20, "Bless the Lord, ye his angels that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word." Angels hearken to the voice of God's word. When you speak the word of God, angels snap to attention. They say, "We have an assignment." And they begin to move on your behalf. This is why you must not just think good thoughts. You must speak. Angels do not respond to your thoughts. They respond to your words. When you decree, "No weapon formed against me shall prosper," angels begin to dismantle every weapon the enemy has fashioned. When you declare, "The Lord is my shepherd, I shall not want," angels begin to release provision. When you prophesy, "The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord." Angels begin to orchestrate divine connections and appointments. But if you wake up in the morning and the first thing you do is complain, murmmore, speak defeat, speak failure, you are giving demons an assignment instead of angels. You are creating an atmosphere for the enemy to operate. This is why the Bible says in Ephesians 4:29, "Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers." Every word that comes out of your mouth is either edifying or corrupting. It is either building or destroying. It is either releasing grace or releasing curse. There is no neutral ground. This is why you cannot afford to be careless with your words especially in the morning when you are setting the tone for the day. Now I want to show you something profound from the book of Mark. In Mark 11:23, Jesus said, "For verily I say unto you, that whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea, and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass, he shall have whatsoever he saith." Notice Jesus did not say, "Whosoever shall think." He said, "Whosoever shall say." He didn't say whosoever shall wish or whosoever shall hope. He said whosoever shall say, and notice that the word say appears three times in that one verse, shall say unto this mountain shall believe that those things which he saith, he shall have whatsoever he saith. This is not by accident. God is emphasizing the power of your spoken word. You must say it. You must declare it. You must prophesy it. Faith in your heart must be articulated with your mouth. Romans 10:10 confirms this. For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness, and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation. There is a partnership between your heart and your mouth. What you believe in your heart must be spoken with your mouth for it to manifest. This is divine order. This is spiritual protocol. So when you wake up in the morning, you are not just wishing for a good day. You are decreeing a good day. You are not hoping things will work out. You are commanding things to work out according to the word of God. You are not passively waiting to see what happens. You are actively creating what happens by speaking life. Let me pray with you. Father in the name of Jesus, I decree that every believer hearing this word shall step into a new dimension of authority. They shall understand that they are not victims of circumstance but creators of atmosphere. Their words shall carry weight in the spirit realm. Their declarations shall shake kingdoms of darkness. And when they speak, heaven shall move, angels shall mobilize, and demons shall flee in the mighty name of Jesus. Now, there is something else I need you to understand. When you speak life into your day, you are not just affecting yourself, you are affecting everyone connected to you. Proverbs 11:11 says, "By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked. Your words have the power to exalt or overthrow. When you speak blessing, when you speak life, the atmosphere around you changes. Your family benefits. Your workplace benefits. Your community benefits. This is why the enemy fights against believers who know how to use their mouth. A believer who understands the power of spoken word is a dangerous weapon in the kingdom of God. You are not just living your life. You are legislating from the heavenlies. Ephesians 2:6 says that God hath raised us up together and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus. You are seated in heavenly places. This is a position of authority. And from that position, you speak, you decree, you declare and things shift in the realm of the earth. I want you to imagine a king sitting on his throne. When a king speaks, his word becomes law. Ecclesiastes 8:4 says, "Where the word of a king is, there is power." And who may say unto him, "What doest thou?" You are a king. 1 Peter 2:9 says, "You are a royal priesthood. You are of royal blood. You carry royal authority. And when you speak from your position of authority in Christ, your word carries power." The problem is that many believers do not know who they are. They wake up in the morning talking like slaves instead of kings. They speak defeat. They speak lack. They speak limitation. And then they wonder why they keep experiencing defeat, lack, and limitation. You cannot rise above the level of your confession. Proverbs 6:2 says, "Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth. Thou art taken with the words of thy mouth." If you keep saying, "I'm broke," you will remain broke. If you keep saying, "I'm sick," you will remain sick. If you keep saying, "I can't," you won't. You are creating a snare with your words. But when you begin to align your words with the word of God, you create a pathway for blessing. You open the windows of heaven, you give God something to walk with. Somebody shout, "From today, I will speak life. I will speak blessing. I will speak victory. My mouth shall no longer be a weapon in the hands of the enemy, but a weapon in the hands of God in the mighty name of Jesus." Let me give you a practical strategy for speaking life into your day. The moment you wake up, before you check your phone, before you talk to anyone, before you do anything else, open your mouth and begin to worship God. Psalm 34:1 says, "I will bless the Lord at all times. His praise shall continually be in my mouth." Start with praise. Thank God for life. Thank him for breath. Thank him for a new day. Then begin to decree the word of God over your life. I call this morning decrees. Here's what I do. I take scriptures and I personalize them. I don't just read them. I decree them. For example, Psalm 23. I don't just read, "The Lord is my shepherd." I say, "The Lord is my shepherd. I shall not want." He makes me to lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside the still waters. He restores my soul. You see the difference? I'm making it personal. I'm declaring it over my life. Psalm 91, I don't just read it. I decree it. I dwell in the secret place of the most high. I abide under the shadow of the almighty. I say of the Lord, he is my refuge and my fortress. My God, in him will I trust. You personalize the word. You make it yours. And when you do that, something shifts in the spirit realm. Then you begin to speak specific blessings over your day. Father, I thank you that this day is blessed. I thank you that I walk in divine favor. Every person I encounter today shall show me favor. Every door I need to open shall open for me. Every provision I need shall come to me. Every wisdom I require shall be granted to me. I am the head and not the tail. I am above only and not beneath. I am blessed coming in and blessed going out. You see, you are painting a picture with your words. You are creating a blueprint in the spirit realm and throughout the day angels are working to manifest what you have spoken. This is why by the time challenges arise you have already created a spiritual atmosphere of victory. The devil wants to speak first but you beat him to it. You spoke life before he could speak death. Let me show you something from the book of numbers. When the 12 spies went to spy out the land of Canaan, 10 of them came back with an evil report. Numbers 13:33 says, "And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anarch, which come of the giants, and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight." Notice what they said. We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight. They saw themselves as grasshoppers. So the giant saw them as grasshoppers. How you see yourself and what you speak about yourself determines how others see you and how circumstances respond to you. But Joshua and Caleb had a different report. Numbers 14-9 says, "Only rebel not ye against the Lord. Neither fear ye the people of the land, for they are bred for us. Their defense is departed from them and the Lord is with us. Fear them not." They called the giants bread. They said, "These giants are our food. We're going to consume them." Same situation, different confession. And guess what? Out of all the Israelites who came out of Egypt, only Joshua and Caleb entered the promised land. Why? Because their confession was different. They spoke life. They spoke victory. They spoke faith. This is what I want you to do every morning. Look at your challenges and call them bread. Call them food for your testimony. Don't magnify the problem. magnify the solution. Don't talk about how big the giant is. Talk about how big your God is. Don't focus on the storm. Focus on the one who calms the storm. Lift up your hands. Father, I decree over every believer hearing this word. Their eyes shall be open to see challenges as opportunities. Every giant in their life shall become bread. Every obstacle shall become a stepping stone. Every adversity shall become a setup for promotion. They shall no longer speak fear. They shall speak faith. They shall no longer speak defeat. They shall speak victory in the mighty name of Jesus. Now, let me address something. Some people say, "Pastor, I've been speaking positive things, but nothing is changing." Let me tell you something. Speaking life is not magic. It is not a formula. It is a lifestyle of faith. Mark 11:24 says, "What things soever ye desire when you pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them." There must be faith behind your words. You cannot speak doubt and expect faith results. You cannot decree the promises of God with your mouth and negate them with your thoughts. James 1:6-7 says, "But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that waverth is like a wave of the sea, driven with the wind and tossed. For let not that man think that he shall receive anything of the Lord. You must speak life with conviction, with certainty, with unwavering faith. And sometimes there is a time gap between when you speak and when you see. But that's when you must continue speaking. Don't change your confession because you don't see immediate results. Habacook 2:3 says, "For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak and not lie. Though it tight for it, because it will surely come, it will not tarry." Keep speaking, keep decreeing, keep declaring. The manifestation is coming. The breakthrough is on the way. But you must not grow weary in speaking life. Galatians 6:9 says, "And let us not be weary in welloing, for in due season we shall reap if we faint not." I decree over you right now, you shall not faint. Your faith shall not fail. You shall continue to speak life until you see life manifest in the mighty name of Jesus. There is another dimension I want to touch on. When you speak life into your day, you are also silencing the voice of the accuser. Revelation 12:10 calls the devil the accuser of our brethren. He accuses you before God day and night. He brings up your past. He reminds God of your failures. He tells God why you don't deserve blessing. But Romans 8:33 says, "Who shall lay anything to the charge of God's elect? It is God that justifieth. Who is he that condemnth? It is Christ that died year rather that is risen again who is even at the right hand of God who also maketh intercession for us. When you speak life when you declare the word of God you are agreeing with what Jesus is saying about you at the right hand of the father. Jesus is not accusing you. He's interceding for you. He's advocating for you. And when you open your mouth and speak the promises of God, you are joining your voice with his voice, you are coming into agreement with heaven. And the Bible says in Amos 3:3, "Can two walk together except they be agreed?" When you and Jesus are in agreement, the devil's accusations become powerless. So every morning before the accuser speaks, you speak. You declare, "I am the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. I am justified by faith. I am accepted in the beloved. I am forgiven. I am redeemed. I am sanctified. The blood of Jesus speaks better things on my behalf. When you make these declarations, you silence the enemy. You shut his mouth. You render his accusations null and void. Let me pray. Father, in the name of Jesus, I decree that the voice of the accuser is silenced over every believer hearing this word. Every accusation of the enemy, we cancel it by the blood of Jesus. Every lie he has spoken about them, we reject it in Jesus name. And we decree that their identity is in Christ, their righteousness is in Christ, their acceptance is in Christ, and no weapon formed against them shall prosper, and every tongue that rises against them in judgment shall be condemned in the mighty name of Jesus. Now, I want to give you some specific declarations to speak every morning. Write this down. Commit them to memory. Make them part of your daily confession. Number one, this is the day that the Lord has made. I will rejoice and be glad in it. Psalm 118- 24. Don't wait to see if the day is good before you rejoice. Rejoice first. Rejoicing is a weapon. It creates an atmosphere for God to move. Number two, no weapon formed against me shall prosper, and every tongue that rises against me in judgment, I shall condemn. Isaiah 54-17. Declare your protection. Declare your vindication. Number three, the Lord shall cause my enemies that rise up against me to be smitten before my face. They shall come out against me one way and flee before me seven ways. Deuteronomy 28:7. Speak defeat over every plan of the enemy. Number four, the Lord shall open unto me his good treasure, the heaven to give rain onto my land in season, and to bless all the work of my hand. Deuteronomy 28:12. Decree provision. Decree blessing. Number five, I can do all things through Christ which strengthens me. Philippians 4:13, declare your ability in Christ. Number six, my God shall supply all my need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus. Philippians 4:19, speak over your financial needs. Number seven, by his stripes I am healed. Isaiah 53:5, decree healing over your body. Number 8, the Lord is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The Lord is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid? Psalm 27:1, speak courage. Speak boldness. Number nine, I am more than a conqueror through him that loved me. Romans 8:37, declare your victory. Number 10, surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life. Psalm 23-6. Decree that goodness and mercy are pursuing you. These are not just nice words. These are spiritual weapons. When you speak them, you are activating the power of God. You are releasing the angels. You are binding the enemy. You are creating an atmosphere of victory. Somebody shout, "I receive these declarations. I will speak them every morning. My day shall be filled with the glory of God in Jesus' name. Now, let me show you what happens when you consistently speak life into your day over time. You begin to develop what I call prophetic momentum. Every day that you speak life, you are building spiritual muscle. Your faith grows stronger. Your authority increases. Your sensitivity to the spirit becomes sharper. And you begin to notice that things that used to trouble you no longer have power over you. Situations that used to shake you no longer move you. People who used to intimidate you no longer affect you. Why? Because you have been speaking life. You have been building yourself up in your most holy faith. You have been creating a spiritual fortress around yourself with the word of God. Jude 1:20 says, "But ye beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost." Every time you speak the word, you are building. You are constructing. You are fortifying. And over time, you become unshakable. You become immovable. You become like a tree planted by the rivers of water that brings forth fruit in its season and whose leaves shall not wither. This is why the enemy fights against believers who have a powerful morning devotion. He knows that if he can get you to skip your morning time with God, if he can get you to rush into your day without speaking life, he has an advantage. But when you make it a non-negotiable, when you determine that no matter what, you will speak life into your day. You become a threat to the kingdom of darkness. Let me tell you something. The devil is not afraid of Christians who go to church. He's afraid of Christians who pray. He's not afraid of Christians who know the Bible. He's afraid of Christians who speak the Bible. He's not afraid of Christians who have faith in their hearts. He's afraid of Christians who release that faith through their mouths. This is why James 4:7 says, "Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil and he will flee from you." When you submit to God by speaking his word and when you resist the devil by using your mouth as a weapon, he has no choice but to flee. But you must speak. You must open your mouth. Silence is not an option. Lift your hands. Father, I decree that every person hearing this word shall become a voice in their generation. They shall no longer be silent. They shall no longer be intimidated. They shall open their mouths and speak life. They shall decree victory. They shall prophesy breakthrough and the enemy shall flee before them seven different ways in the mighty name of Jesus. There's something else. When you speak life into your day, you are also creating a legacy for the next generation. Psalm 78:4 says, "We will not hide them from their children, showing to the generation to come the praises of the Lord and his strength and his wonderful works that he had done." Your children are watching you. Your family is watching you. When they see you waking up every morning speaking the word, praying, decreeing, declaring, you are teaching them how to live. You are showing them that life is spiritual before it is physical. You are demonstrating that victory is first won in the place of prayer before it manifests in the place of action. You are leaving them a blueprint for success. Don't just teach your children motivational principles. Teach them to speak life. Teach them to decree the word of God. Teach them that their tongue is a weapon. Teach them that death and life are in the power of the tongue. Give them this inheritance. It is more valuable than money. It is more precious than property. I want to close with this. Jesus said in John 6:63, it is the spirit that quickenth. The flesh profitth nothing. The words that I speak unto you, they are spirit and they are life. The words of Jesus are spirit and life. And when you speak his words, your words become spirit and life too. Every morning when you wake up and you speak life, you are releasing the spirit of God into your day. You are releasing life into your circumstances. You are releasing power into your situation. And no matter what the enemy planned, no matter what hell arranged, your words have the final say. So I decree over you right now in the name of Jesus, from this day forward, you shall speak life. Your mouth shall be sanctified. Your tongue shall be consecrated and everything you speak shall align with the will and the word of God. The enemy shall no longer have the first word in your day. You shall speak first. You shall decree first. You shall prophesy first. And by the time the sun sets today, you will see the manifestation of what you spoke this morning. Angels will have moved. Demons will have fled. Doors will have opened. Provision will have come. Favor will have manifested. Healing will have occurred. Breakthroughs will have happened. All because you spoke life into your day before the enemy could speak death. Somebody shout the biggest hallelujah you've ever shouted. Give God the highest praise because you understand now that your words have power. Your declarations have authority. And when you speak, heaven moves in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.
